# E0361: a lens reads a field that may be absent

A lens reads a field that may be absent from the input: an optional field, with
no test that it is present. For the instances that lack it, the lens produces
nothing there. Write the field under a presence test, or give it a fallback.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				b:  string
				c?: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			a: input.c
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			b: input.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0361]: lens 0.0->1.0 is not total at a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0
  --> lineage.cue:23:7
   |
23 |             a: input.c
   |                ^^^^^
   |
   = note: a in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 copies input.c, which may be absent: input.c is optional in the source schema; write the field under if input.c != _|_
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule source-absent)
```
